name: logo
label: Logo
help_text: White version of the logo shown in the header.

name: invited_by_prefix
label: Invited By Prefix Text
help_text: Text before the referrer's name. The name is appended automatically from the URL parameter ?refname=.

name: invited_by_fallback
label: Fallback Heading (no referrer)
help_text: Heading shown when no referral URL parameter is present.
default: You've been invited to join VIPSCLUB.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: subtitle
label: Subtitle Text
help_text: Subtitle text shown below the invited-by heading.
default: Join thousands of members already earning rewards with IPS Partners.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme gradient default

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
